title: Log-book entry header
description: The YAML header of one log-book entry (a Markdown file). Only date, authors, kind, project and title are required; everything else is optional, so a quick note stays quick. Paths are relative to the entry's folder (entries/YYYY/).

date.description: The day of the work (the author's statement).

time.description: Local time, HH:MM; the same as HHMM in the file name.

authors.description: First = the person submitting. Handles from people.yaml in a central book; free names in a standalone book.

with.description: Tool that assisted, e.g. claude: shown as '(with assistance from Claude Code)'.

also.description: Other projects this entry belongs to.

runs.description: DAQ run ids, archiver time windows, cluster job ids.

level.description: kind: redaction (docs/REDACTION.md of the central book).

resolves.description: Open issue or todo blocks of earlier entries that this entry settles: <entry-id>#<block-id>.

order.description: kind: order. The order's number or name.

items.description: kind: order. What was ordered; an item without `arrived` is the open item #item-<n>.

info.description: A quote's file name, a link, or a note.

vendor.description: Where it was bought; without it, the view takes the vendor from the quote's name or the link.

arrived.description: Set when the item had arrived before the entry was written (true, or the date).

priority.description: New priorities for open items of earlier entries: {<entry-id>#<block-id>: low | medium | high | asap}. The latest entry that names an item sets its priority.

file.description: The figure, normally the PDF of a labfig version: figures/<name>-vN.pdf. The .svg and .png and the record .yaml next to it are found by name.

kind.description: Default plot. Anything else is held for the export-control confirmation.

library.description: Folder name in the Drive figure library (never a link or an id).

file.description: The processed data the entry shows (CSV, JSON, NPZ), a few MB at most.

describes.description: The figure it is plotted in (file stem).

source.description: Where the raw data lives: Drive folder path, run id, cluster job, repository commit.

backfilled.description: The day the entry was written, when that is more than the allowed delay after `date`.

logged.description: Logged-at time of a migrated entry (ISO 8601), from the source repository's history.

reviewed.description: The author has read the lines the checker flagged and they are harmless; recorded.

release.description: Candidate for a reviewed public release of log-book scenarios (an export the author approves).
